headline: Tesla plans to show its Cybercab robotaxi at the Paris auto show.
score_reason: Two outlets report the plan by headline; a show appearance, not a launch.
importance_line: A show display puts Tesla's driverless-car plans in front of European audiences while EU regulators still weigh its driver-assistance software, but it does not mean rides or sales in Europe.
summary: Automotive News, echoed by a Bloomberg headline, reports that Tesla will showcase its Cybercab robotaxi at the Paris auto show.
notes: Headline only; both pages blocked. Automotive News address calls it a European premiere (not confirmed in text).
